settings.heading: The Budget Alternative to Gildan Blanks
settings.answer: Bayou Blanks is the budget alternative to Gildan blanks. Gildan is the industry-standard brand — you buy it through distributors, usually after logging into a wholesale account, and pay a size upcharge on 2XL and up. Bayou is unbranded liquidation overstock: a flat $4.25/unit, the same price in every size, no account.

settings.text: Gildan is a brand you buy through distributors — Bayou is the unbranded blank itself, sold direct by the pack with no account.
Gildan's wholesale price is usually gated behind a distributor login; Bayou shows the per-unit price right on the page.
Bayou is a flat $4.25/unit ($2.92 by the 12-pack), the same for every size.
Gildan adds a plus-size upcharge — about +$2 at 2XL, +$3 at 3XL, +$5 at 4XL — while Bayou charges the same $4.25/unit through 4XL–5XL, so extended sizes is where Bayou wins on price.
Where Gildan wins: brand recognition, around 70 colors, consistent sizing, and rock-bottom pricing on basic S–XL tees at high volume.
Where Bayou wins: the lowest no-strings per-unit on solid blanks — no account, no brand premium, the same price in every size — ideal for plus and extended sizes, side hustles, teams, and makers.

settings.question: Does Bayou Blanks sell Gildan?
settings.answer: No. Bayou doesn't sell Gildan or any brand — we sell unbranded liquidation overstock blanks. Think of us as the budget alternative to a Gildan blank: the same kind of solid cotton tee, without the brand label or the brand price, at a flat $4.25/unit.

settings.question: Is Bayou Blanks cheaper than Gildan?
settings.answer: It depends on the size. On basic S–XL tees bought at high volume through a distributor, Gildan's rock-bottom brand pricing can match or beat our $4.25/unit. But Gildan adds a plus-size upcharge — about +$2 at 2XL, +$3 at 3XL, +$5 at 4XL — while Bayou charges the same $4.25/unit through 4XL–5XL, so on extended and plus sizes Bayou is usually the cheaper blank.

settings.question: How do you normally buy Gildan blanks?
settings.answer: Through a wholesale distributor — S&S Activewear, BlankApparel, BlankStyle, BulkApparel and others — and wholesale pricing is often shown only after you create an account and log in. Bayou shows the per-unit price on the page and you can buy a single pack with no account.

settings.question: Do I need an account or resale certificate to buy from Bayou?
settings.answer: No. Bayou is open to anyone — no account, no business, no resale certificate. The price is on the page and the minimum is a single pack.

settings.question: What's the catch with unbranded liquidation blanks?
settings.answer: Selection and consistency. You're buying curated overstock — around 85 styles — not Gildan's roughly 70-color, sold-everywhere lineup, and a given color can sell through. If you need an exact brand and color restocked on demand, Gildan's range is deeper; if you want the lowest no-strings per-unit on a solid blank, Bayou wins.

settings.question: Gildan or Bayou — which should I choose?
settings.answer: Choose Gildan if you need brand-name consistency, a specific color from a wide range, or rock-bottom pricing on basic small-size tees at high volume. Choose Bayou if you want the lowest price with no account, the same price in every size, and especially if you're buying plus or extended sizes.
